# partiteai_boundary (Resource)

A boundary: rules that each refuse something in conversations on the meshes, or created through the access points, it is attached to, and modifications that set things on what those conversations do. Attach it with `boundary_ids` on `partiteai_mesh` or `partiteai_access_point`.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Resource name

### Optional

- `description` (String) Resource description
- `modifications` (Attributes List) The modifications, made in order (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--modifications))
- `report_only` (Boolean) Every rule reports what it would refuse rather than refusing it, and no modification is made
- `rules` (Attributes List) The rules, checked in order (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--rules))

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Timestamp when the resource was created
- `id` (String) Resource identifier
- `updated_at` (String) Timestamp when the resource was last updated
- `warnings` (List of String) What is likely wrong with the boundary, such as an expression that reads something that can be missing without checking first

<a id="nestedatt--modifications"></a>
### Nested Schema for `modifications`

Required:

- `action` (String) The action the modification sets things on: `CONVERSATION_CREATE`, `REQUEST_CREATE` or `TOOL_CALL`
- `name` (String) Name of the modification, unique in the boundary

Optional:

- `set_arguments` (Map of String) For `TOOL_CALL`: arguments to set on the call, each name with a CEL expression that gives its value. The model doesn't see an argument a boundary sets.
- `set_tags` (Map of String) For `CONVERSATION_CREATE` and `REQUEST_CREATE`: tags to set on what the action creates, each name with a CEL expression that gives its values. A string sets one value, a list several, and an empty list removes the tag.
- `set_tracing` (String) For `CONVERSATION_CREATE`: a CEL expression that gives whether the conversation is traced
- `when` (String) CEL expression that decides whether the modification applies. It can't read a tool call's arguments. Left out, the modification applies to every action of its kind.


<a id="nestedatt--rules"></a>
### Nested Schema for `rules`

Required:

- `action` (String) The action the rule checks: `CONVERSATION_CREATE`, `REQUEST_CREATE`, `SKILL_PROVIDE`, `TOOL_PROVIDE`, `MEMORY_SEARCH_PROVIDE`, `CONVERSATION_HISTORY_PROVIDE` or `TOOL_CALL`
- `effect` (String) `DENY` refuses the action. `ASK` makes a tool call wait for the user to approve it, and is only for `TOOL_CALL`.
- `name` (String) Name of the rule, unique in the boundary

Optional:

- `message` (String) Told to whoever the rule refuses, or asks to approve. It can embed CEL expressions as `${...}`, which read what the rule's `when` reads; `$${` writes a literal `${`.
- `report_only` (Boolean) The rule reports what it would refuse rather than refusing it
- `when` (String) CEL expression that decides whether the rule applies. Left out, the rule applies to every action of its kind.
